summary: On Friday the CEO of Cloudflare announced that AWS had pulled their re:Invent booth less than two months before the event. I'm really struggling to identify something dumber AWS could have done; suddenly everything Cloudflare says about AWS seeing them as a threat rings truer than it did a week ago. And they're probably right! Developer mindshare is skyrocketing for Cloudflare, whereas AWS has been desperately pushing Kiro every chance it gets—to the detriment of its own developer credibility. I don't know what it is they think they're doing over there, but it's pretty clear that at least as far as developers are concerned? It's not working.
